I think this is an opportunity for Warsh to show the market he can't be corrupted tbh

Seems to be consensus on this site that Trump's ceasefire will allow Warsh to lean dove with lower oil and yields

But I don't think Warsh doesn't understand what's going on here

So he either takes the Trump bait and validates that he can be manipulated, or he doesn't and firmly shows the market that this is his fed, not Trump's...

No one thinks he will (he probably won't), but I won't be surprised if he does, and this will be why imo
